experiments.title: WP-RAPM statistical priors
experiments.test: Train Box15 and rich statistical models on past rolling five-year progress-WP RAPM, update each with one season of WP possessions, then score the same next-season games.
experiments.result: Zero-centered WP-RAPM had 0.981 RMSE. Box15 WP-AIO had 1.130; rich WP-AIO had 1.119.
experiments.decision: Reject both priors. Each raised paired next-season game MSE on all five folds. Keep zero-centered WP-RAPM as the research control.

experiments.title: Single-season penalty and score-control sweep
experiments.test: Select 20 offense/defense penalty pairs and five score-state choices on 2015 to 2022. Diagnose the frozen choices on the same 2023 to 2026 games.
experiments.result: The early folds selected 3000/6000, but that pair lost to 3000/3000 later. The score-state winner was none. Historical calibration reduced the selected model's predicted-margin spread and later MSE.
experiments.decision: Keep 3000/4500/300 as the robust single-season research setting. Do not increase defense shrinkage to 6000. Do not add score buckets.

experiments.title: One- to ten-year RAPM and age context
experiments.test: Score every plain horizon on identical 2024 to 2026 games. Add fixed, jointly estimated lineup-age terms to the five- through ten-year variants.
experiments.result: Plain RAPM was best at 4 years (14.904 RMSE). Age-conditional RAPM was best at 7 years (14.710).
experiments.decision: Use age context only for predictive research. Keep neutral retrospective RAPM separate from ratings that know each future lineup's age.

experiments.title: Single-season defense shrinkage
experiments.test: Fit one-season RAPM at 3000/3000 and 3000/4500. Score both on the same next-season games across 12 folds from 2015 to 2026.
experiments.result: Mean RMSE fell from 13.695 to 13.680. Reference-minus-candidate MSE was 0.405, with a 95% interval from 0.185 to 0.636.
experiments.decision: Use 3000/4500/300 as the single-season research successor. Rebuild dependent AIO artifacts before public promotion.

experiments.title: Five-season defense shrinkage
experiments.test: Compare 3000/3000 and 3000/4500 on the stored five-season RAPM matrices. Use five earlier selection seasons and three later diagnostics.
experiments.result: The split penalty slightly lowered selection RMSE but reduced correlation. On 2024 to 2026, RMSE rose from 14.936 to 14.950 and correlation fell from 0.366 to 0.361.
experiments.decision: Keep 3000/3000/300 for five-season RAPM.

experiments.title: Age and score controls
experiments.test: Keep possession points unchanged. Fit smooth lineup-age controls and ten signed score-margin buckets jointly beside player and home columns. Select settings on 2025, then compare normal, age only, score only, and age plus score on the same reused 2026 games.
experiments.result: Player-only RMSE changes were age +0.158, score +0.036, and joint +0.101. Keeping known age at prediction time changed age-only RMSE by -0.012.
experiments.decision: Do not promote. Every player-only rating loses; known age is neutral for pregame prediction; score buckets also lose.

experiments.title: Full-span same-age RAPM
experiments.test: Fit offense and defense age indicators jointly with 1997-2025 player RAPM. Select age shrinkage on 2025 and check ordinary, age-27, and actual-age predictions on the same reused 2026 games.
experiments.result: Age-27 player-only RMSE changed by +0.052. Adding actual lineup ages changed it by -0.163.
experiments.decision: Keep the conditional age control for research. The age-27 leaderboard is not a predictive upgrade.

experiments.title: Five-point score buckets
experiments.test: Estimate 5-point lead buckets on 2014-24, select the score-control and offense/defense penalties on 2025, then compare the frozen winner with 3000/3000 RAPM on the same 2026 games.
experiments.result: The selected candidate changed 2026 RMSE by +0.017; its paired 95% interval was -0.021 to +0.055.
experiments.decision: Keep the empirical 5-point curve. Reject score buckets and differential penalties in production points RAPM.

experiments.title: Factor RAPM reconstruction
experiments.test: Fit annual true-shooting, turnover, and offensive-rebound RAPMs. Learn the factor-to-total mapping on 2024, select on 2025, and diagnose on qualified 2026 players.
experiments.result: 2026 net correlation 0.974, R squared 0.948, RMSE 0.470.
experiments.decision: Successful reconstruction, not independent validation: factor and total RAPM share lineups and season outcomes.

experiments.title: JE categorical score-state RAPM
experiments.test: Fit exact pre-possession score-margin indicators jointly with player RAPM on 2014-25, then check neutral player ratings on reused 2026 games.
experiments.result: Neutral 2026 margin RMSE changed by +0.143; the paired 95% interval was +0.043 to +0.244.
experiments.decision: Keep the score-state curve as context. Reject the adjusted player rating.

experiments.title: Joint actual-clock score-state RAPM
experiments.test: Keep possession points unchanged. Fit eight actual six-minute signed-margin columns jointly beside player offense, player defense, and home; select only context shrinkage on 2025 and check neutral player ratings on reused 2026.
experiments.result: The selected context penalty was 3000. Neutral 2026 RMSE changed by +0.031 and correlation by +0.010.
experiments.decision: Reject for production. It improves correlation slightly but worsens calibrated margin RMSE, and its paired interval crosses zero.

experiments.title: Rubber-band adjustment
experiments.test: Five whole-game lineup cross-fit folds per season. Develop on 2024, select shape on 2025, check on reused 2026.
experiments.result: Six-minute bins with margin clipped at 15. 2026 possession MSE improved 0.028%; all 2,000 game resamples improved. The 10 and 15-point caps were statistically tied.
experiments.decision: Retain the descriptive curve. Its adjusted-RAPM test appears below.

experiments.title: Rubber-band adjusted RAPM
experiments.test: Fit the clock and fixed 25-possession progress curves on 2024-25. Remove each curve from the player target, then compare neutral player-only ratings with normal RAPM on the same 1,228 reused 2026 games.
experiments.result: Clock-adjusted RMSE changed by +0.018 and correlation by +0.009. Possession-adjusted RMSE changed by +0.026 and correlation by +0.009. Both paired RMSE intervals cross zero.
experiments.decision: Keep the descriptive curve. Do not promote either adjusted player rating.

experiments.title: Age translation
experiments.test: Walk forward from trailing 1, 3, and 5-season annual ratings. Compare 0.1, 0.5, 1, and 2-year smoothing bandwidths.
experiments.result: One year won net RMSE in every history window. Improvements were 0.014, 0.027, and 0.036 points.
experiments.decision: Use for forecasts only. Retrospective RAPM stays age-neutral.

experiments.title: Residual unit layers
experiments.test: Fit each residual unit order after player RAPM. Select shrinkage on 2025 and check on reused 2026.
experiments.result: 2026 RMSE changes: pair +0.035, trio +0.070, four +0.036, five -0.004.
experiments.decision: Reject 2 to 4. Five-player result is too small to promote.

experiments.title: Pair, trio, four-man, and lineup RAPM
experiments.test: Fit raw possession points using only k-player offense units, k-player defense units, and home advantage. Use five training seasons, select shrinkage on 2025, then compare with one-player RAPM on the same 1,228 games in reused 2026.
experiments.result: 2026 RMSE changes versus one-player RAPM: pair +0.471, trio +0.780, four-man +1.022, lineup +1.226. Pair coverage was 41.4%; lineup coverage was 3.7%.
experiments.decision: Reject as player-impact replacements under the frozen exposure rules. Sparsity worsens sharply with unit size.

experiments.title: Low-sample pair bucketing
experiments.test: Compare a hard 500-possession pair cutoff with exposure-bucket and inverse-exposure shrinkage on 2025. Only advance the selected pair model to 2026; stop higher-order tests unless it beats one-player RAPM.
experiments.result: Rare-pair retention raised 2025 slot coverage to 48.7% from 43.0% but lost. Hard-floor pair RAPM then changed 2026 RMSE by +0.471.
experiments.decision: Stop after pairs. More coverage did not improve prediction, so bucketed trio, quartet, and lineup fits are not justified.

experiments.title: Rolling five-year RAPM with intervals
experiments.test: Reuse the validated 3000/3000/300 sufficient statistics for every 2014-18 through 2022-26 window. Compute fixed-window homoskedastic analytic ridge sampling intervals and verify point-estimate parity.
experiments.result: 8,620 player-window rows across 9 windows; maximum point-estimate mismatch 1.22e-07.
experiments.decision: Ready for the local production-candidate table. Intervals do not cover game clustering, ridge bias, or selecting a peak window.

experiments.title: RAPM target horizon bake-off
experiments.test: Fit 1-, 3-, 5-, and 6-year RAPM windows, score all four on the same seven next seasons from 2020 to 2026, and build one descriptive full 2014-2026 fit.
experiments.result: Equal-season mean RMSE: 5y 14.140, 6y 14.177, 3y 14.183, 1y 14.376. Five years also had the highest mean margin correlation at 0.368.
experiments.decision: Use five-year RAPM as the predictive/stable SPM target challenger. Keep one-year RAPM as the retrospective single-season public estimand.

experiments.title: Six-sided factor RAPM
experiments.test: Fit offense and defense for shooting TS, turnovers, and offensive rebounds on exact opportunity rows from 2024 to 2026.
experiments.result: 743,946 possessions; 98.40% of relevant events mapped.
experiments.decision: Keep as descriptive skill ratings. The factors do not add to total RAPM.

experiments.title: FT and 3P luck-adjusted RAPM
experiments.test: Replace realized offensive free throws and threes with leave-current-game-out player-season empirical-Bayes expected makes. Fit on 2024-25 and score actual 2026 game margins against normal RAPM.
experiments.result: RMSE changed by -0.093; paired 95% -0.237 to +0.057. Correlation rose from 0.334 to 0.343.
experiments.decision: Keep as a research challenger. The point estimate improves, but the paired RMSE interval crosses zero.

experiments.title: Teammate eFG RAPM
experiments.test: On every field-goal attempt, replace the shooter in the offensive lineup with a universal dummy. Fit four-teammate offensive eFG effect and five-defender shot-defense effect on 2024-26.
experiments.result: 644,307 shot rows fitted; 2,225 source shots lacked a matching terminal-lineup shooter and were excluded.
experiments.decision: Display as descriptive shooting context. It is not causal spacing or shot quality.

experiments.title: Ryan Davis RAPM comparison
experiments.test: Match the public 2019 tutorial ratings to CourtSignal's 2019 terminal-lineup zero-prior RAPM by NBA player ID.
experiments.result: Across 527 players, net Pearson correlation was 0.934 and rank correlation was 0.919.
experiments.decision: The implementations agree strongly on ordering. CourtSignal is less shrunk; this is parser and specification agreement, not predictive validation.

experiments.title: External RAPM and plus-minus checks
experiments.test: Match exact player IDs and windows where available. Reproduce the local AuPM formula and a game-level margin ridge. Report WOWY and on/off only as different-estimand agreement checks.
experiments.result: Ryan Davis pooled annual net RAPM: r=0.967; exact 5y windows: r=0.957; exact 3y windows: r=0.980; current xRAPM 3y: r=0.897.
experiments.decision: The exact-key checks show strong implementation agreement. Different-estimand correlations are diagnostics, not validation targets.

experiments.title: Multinomial RAPM
experiments.test: Fit 0, 1, 2, and 3-plus point probabilities. Select alpha on 2025 and compare with linear points RAPM on reused 2026.
experiments.result: 2026 game RMSE 15.508 versus 15.473 for linear RAPM.
experiments.decision: Reject as a predictor. Keep only for outcome-shape research.

experiments.title: Win-probability RAPM
experiments.test: Tune offense and defense penalties on 2025 to 2026, then fit conserved rolling five-year WP credit from 2014 to 2026 with player-neutral surfaces trained only on prior seasons.
experiments.result: 3000 offense / 10000 defense improved 2026 game-total RMSE by -0.0057. All 25 rolling windows conserve game WP within 1.11e-15.
experiments.decision: Use the tuned penalties for WP research only. WP credit is leverage attribution, not points impact.

experiments.title: Full-span age-adjusted coach RAPM
experiments.test: Fit player, lineup-age, coach, and home effects jointly from 1997 to 2025. Select coach shrinkage on 2025, diagnose on reused 2026, and compare the full fit with xRAPM's coach table.
experiments.result: Coach terms changed 2026 RMSE by +0.0109; the paired 95% interval was +0.0067 to +0.0151. Net correlation with xRAPM was 0.802 across 188 matched coaches.
experiments.decision: Reject coach terms for prediction. Keep the leaderboard as descriptive association after player and age controls.

experiments.title: Conserved point channels
experiments.test: Fit one-point, two-point, and three-plus targets with the same design and factorization as RAPM.
experiments.result: 1,229,744 possessions; summed ratings match RAPM within 1.32e-07 points per 100.
experiments.decision: Keep as the additive scoring decomposition.

experiments.title: Infinite RAPM
experiments.test: Walk a RAPM prior through 2012, 2015, 2018, and 2021, then compare the chained rating with the zero-prior reference.
experiments.result: Depth-three chain correlation fell to 0.5933 and degradation grew with each update.
experiments.decision: Reject repeated prior chaining.

experiments.title: Learned recency buckets
experiments.test: Fit unrestricted age weights, inspect their shape, then compare with simple exponential decay across folds.
experiments.result: The learned weights were non-monotone and failed to transfer. Exponential decay won both folds.
experiments.decision: Reject free buckets. Time decay itself remains parked.

experiments.title: Teammate outcome RAPM
experiments.test: For each player-opportunity, remove that player's own event and control the other four teammates and five opponents with separate nuisance coefficients. Fit 2024-26 only.
experiments.result: 743,946 possessions. Named assister, stealer, blocker, and rebounder lineup coverage ranged from 98.3% to 99.8%.
experiments.decision: Keep as descriptive association. Role and lineup selection can still drive the coefficients.

experiments.title: Observable play-channel RAPM
experiments.test: Fit rim assists, transition points, three-point points, free-throw points, midrange attempts, rim points, and eight mutually exclusive shot-finish channels on 2024-26 possessions.
experiments.result: Mapped 98.44% of eligible source events and attributed 98.65% of official points to named scorers.
experiments.decision: Publish as finish and outcome context, not Synergy playtype RAPM.

experiments.title: Five-year decay plus actual age
experiments.test: Select half-life, age shrinkage, and shared player shrinkage on 2025. Refit 2021-25 and compare with ordinary five-year RAPM on the same reused 2026 games.
experiments.result: Selected a 5-year half-life, age penalty 1000, and player penalty 6000. It improved 2025 RMSE by 0.383, then worsened 2026 RMSE by +0.112.
experiments.decision: Do not promote. Keep ordinary five-year RAPM as the production reference.
